title: Personnel of the first Fats session: Ben Whitted, Billy Taylor, Apple Jaws Jones, Al Casey
summary: The group was Autrey, alto and clarinet player Ben Whitted from Charlie Johnson's band, Billy Taylor, a drummer he nicknamed Apple Jaws Jones, and a very young Al Casey.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who -- on this first session you did, Herman, who was in the group at that time? Gene? Gene Sedric?
No.
No?
No. No. I'm glad you asked me that. Nobody ever mentions his name. He's gone now. Is -- ahhhh -- alto saxophone player. Ben Whittig.
I remember the name. Ben Whitted.
Ben Whitted. You remember the name now?
I remember the name, right.

And nobody mentions him, and nobody ever asks me about him, but -- but he was a darned good musician. Oh, he was quite a musician! He was with -- uh, uh -- down at Charlie Johnson's. In that band. Yeah.
In Charlie Johnson's band.
Yeah, playing first clarinet and sax.
This is where Fats is picking people up.
Yeah, and what a man he was. Ben -- oh Ben was just there, and he had -- he looked like Cyclops sitting in there, with his eyes. (Laughs.)
Really?
Oh, he did. He had very bad eyes, and they had --
Was this the first time he played with Fats too? Just like you?
Yeah, the first (unintelligible) and and the last time he came out and played, because Fats asked for him. Had to.
Billy Taylor was on bass? Or who?
Billy Taylor on bass.
And who was on drums?
Ben -- uh, da, da, da, da, da, da -- Apple Jaws Jones.
Apple Jaws Jones.
Yeah, I named him Apple Jaws Jones.
(Laughter.)
Very good drummer. I haven't seen him or played with him since then.
He was just on this one date then?
He made two or three records. For some reason, Victor didn't like him. They (unintelligible).
(Whistles.)
Well, we can check that out.
Okay, I check that out later. He --
How about guitar? Who was on guitar?
Al Casey.
Al Casey.
Al Casey, yes, because Al Casey was a kid then, in school. And he took Al Casey out of school and put him in the union. Afterwards.
Oh, I see.
Uh-huh. Yeah.
But this was now -- when you started with Fats he'd already been making records for Victor, with the group, before that.
No, no, no, no.
Was this the first one?
No, was the first -- I was in the first group. This was it --
This was the first --
-- because Victor had never heard of such animal, and didn't want it. Al -- so Mr. Kirk and a -- not Kirkaby --
